target: abaxial surface of leaf lamina (position slot: abaxial)
fix: Surface adverbs 'abaxially/adaxially' before a hair term must fill the position slot; dropping them moves the quality onto the whole blade.
reason: Only the abaxial side is pubescent or sometimes glabrescent; the adaxial side is always pubescent, so 'blade sometimes glabrescent' is false without the position.
'no scent' at the end of the flower description; the flower is not odorous.
The spike is green, white or yellow; the inflorescence bearer and the three alternatives are right.

fix: 'élargi à la base' / 'widened at the base' must set the place slot (base); without it the whole filament is said to be wide.
reason: The filament is ribbon-like and widened only at the base; 'filament increased width' without the place misstates it.

target: position slot: adaxial surface of leaf lamina
fix: Same cause as A04170: the surface adverb 'adaxially' must fill the position slot.
reason: Only the adaxial side is sparsely villous when young; the abaxial side is tomentose. The young-stage slot is right, but the side is missing.
Stamens shorter than petals; the bearer, the quality and the comparison target are right.

target: range obovate (PATO_0001936) to obovate-elliptic (intermediate), not obovate to elliptic (PATO_0000947)
fix: A hyphenated compound ('obovate-elliptic') is one intermediate value, not an X-to-Y range; the real range is 'X to Y' around it.
reason: The spans show the hyphen inside 'obovate-elliptic' was read as the range connector; the flora's range ends at obovate-elliptic and never reaches elliptic.

fix: 'not seen' / 'unknown' / 'not known' means missing data, not absence; such statements should not become negated presence.
reason: The author did not see a capsule; the flora does not say the capsule is absent.

fix: In moss floras (eflora-mfoc) 'leaves' / 'stem leaves' must map to non-vascular leaf (phyllid), not to the vascular-plant leaf class.
reason: Grimmia is a moss; its stem leaves are phyllids. 'not plicate' is right as a negation.

fix: Position words before the part ('proximal', 'distal', 'lower', 'upper') must fill the position slot.
reason: Only the proximal bract exceeds the inflorescence; Carex distal bracts are much shorter.

fix: 'walls' of a fruit = pericarp; 'on exterior' / 'on interior' set a place slot.
reason: The fruit wall is spongy on the outside and hard on the inside; 'fruit spongy' leaves out both the wall and the outer side.
The filaments are fused with the corolla, so the stamens are fused with it; the free parts are ~1 mm. This holds at stamen level.
The stems are green when young; the young-stage context is set.
Golden pollen is yellow; 'approximately' fits a golden shade.

fix: capsule fruit (PO_0030091) would be more specific
reason: The capsule is reflexed when mature; the mature context is set.
The leaf blade apex is acute; the bearer was correctly replaced by leaf lamina tip.
The corolla is pink to white, a colour continuum.

fix: 'base X' after a blade must put the quality on the blade base (as 'apex' is put on the tip in A04185).
reason: Rounded-to-cuneate describes the blade base, not the whole blade's 2-D shape.

target: place slot: apex of leaf lamina lobe
fix: 'apex X' after a lobe needs the apex place slot when no lobe-apex class exists; otherwise sharpness is put on the whole lobe.
reason: The lobe apex is acute or shortly acuminate; the values are right but the apex is lost.
The mesocarp is whitish or yellowish; '-ish' maps to 'approximately'.
The sepals are shorter than the capsule; the comparison target is the capsule.

fix: 'to N' is a maximum; storing it as N-N is acceptable only if the record is read as an upper bound.
reason: The calyx grows to 3 mm in fruit; the stage context is right.
The leaves are very numerous: present, count 'many'.

fix: lateral leaf vein (PO_0006011) would be more specific
reason: The upper (lateral) veins are simple; the 'upper' position is kept.
80 dm = 800 cm, tree height; the flora's figure is copied faithfully.
The styles are not exserted; the negation scope is right.
Scale leaves are present on mature branches; the whole and stage slots are right.
The leaves are shorter than the culm; the culm maps to stem.

target: range lanceolate-ovate (intermediate) to broadly ovate (FLOPO_0991024 broadly)

reason: The annotation says lanceolate to ovate, which starts at plain lanceolate and leaves out 'broadly ovate'.
